_comment: Read by helpers/content-review-gate.cjs. A PR's risk is the higher of the `Risk:` line in its body and the floor its changed files give; the risk sets the least model that may BUILD it (measured from the session transcript at `gh pr create`) and the least model that may REVIEW it (measured at the approval, written as the review's `Model:` line, read at the merge). Operator order 2026-11-10: nothing critical is built with a smaller model; towards the critical side it is judged, and kept, at the build and at the review. Criteria per risk: docs/content-review.md.
